questions.prompt: PILOT is to AIRCRAFT as CAPTAIN is to
questions.explanation: A pilot commands an aircraft; a captain commands a ship.

questions.prompt: GLOVE is to HAND as SOCK is to
questions.explanation: A glove covers a hand; a sock covers a foot.

questions.prompt: HAPPY is to ECSTATIC as WARM is to
questions.explanation: Ecstatic is an extreme degree of happy; scorching is an extreme degree of warm.

questions.prompt: SCALPEL is to SURGEON as
questions.explanation: A scalpel is a tool used by a surgeon; a brush is a tool used by a painter. A hammer acts on a nail, which is a different relationship.

questions.prompt: DROUGHT is to WATER as FAMINE is to
questions.explanation: A drought is a lack of water; a famine is a lack of food. Hunger is a result of famine, not what is lacking.

questions.prompt: ALTIMETER is to ALTITUDE as THERMOMETER is to
questions.explanation: An altimeter measures altitude; a thermometer measures temperature.

questions.prompt: PREFACE is to BOOK as
questions.explanation: A preface is an introduction that comes before a book; an overture is an introduction that comes before an opera. A chapter is a part of a novel but not an introduction.

questions.prompt: COWARDLY is to BRAVE as FRUGAL is to
questions.explanation: Cowardly is the opposite of brave; frugal is the opposite of wasteful. 'Thrifty' is a synonym, a common trap.

questions.prompt: ARCHITECT is to BLUEPRINT as COMPOSER is to
questions.explanation: An architect creates a blueprint (a written plan); a composer creates a score (written music).

questions.prompt: FISH is to SCHOOL as WOLF is to
questions.explanation: A group of fish is a school; a group of wolves is a pack.

questions.prompt: HOT is to COLD as VICTORY is to
questions.explanation: Opposites. Triumph is a synonym of victory, a common trap.

questions.prompt: PETAL is to FLOWER as PAGE is to
questions.explanation: A petal is part of a flower; a page is part of a book. Paper is what a page is made of, a different relationship.

questions.prompt: COMPASS is to DIRECTION as CLOCK is to
questions.explanation: A compass shows direction; a clock shows time.

questions.prompt: NOVEL is to CHAPTER as SYMPHONY is to
questions.explanation: A novel is divided into chapters; a symphony is divided into movements.

questions.prompt: FLOCK is to SHEEP as SWARM is to
questions.explanation: A flock is a group of sheep; a swarm is a group of bees.

questions.prompt: MINUTE is to HOUR as OUNCE is to
questions.explanation: A minute is a smaller unit of an hour; an ounce is a smaller unit of a pound.

questions.prompt: CARPENTER is to WOOD as MASON is to
questions.explanation: A carpenter works with wood; a mason works with stone.

questions.prompt: DILIGENT is to LAZY as GENEROUS is to
questions.explanation: Opposites. Giving is a synonym of generous, a trap.

questions.prompt: PROLOGUE is to EPILOGUE as BEGINNING is to
questions.explanation: A prologue comes first and an epilogue comes last, as beginning and end do.

questions.prompt: DOCTOR is to HOSPITAL as TEACHER is to
questions.explanation: Where each person works.

questions.prompt: HANGAR is to AIRCRAFT as GARAGE is to
questions.explanation: A hangar shelters aircraft; a garage shelters cars.

questions.prompt: BOLD is to TIMID as VERBOSE is to
questions.explanation: Opposites. Wordy is a synonym of verbose, a trap.

questions.prompt: PAINTER is to CANVAS as SCULPTOR is to
questions.explanation: A painter works on canvas; a sculptor works in marble. A chisel is a tool and a statue is the finished product.

questions.prompt: BREEZE is to HURRICANE as DRIZZLE is to
questions.explanation: A breeze is mild wind and a hurricane is extreme wind; a drizzle is light rain and a downpour is extreme rain.

questions.prompt: KEY is to LOCK as
questions.explanation: A key opens a lock; a password opens an account.

questions.prompt: THIRSTY is to DRINK as
questions.explanation: Drinking relieves thirst; sleep relieves tiredness. Smile and tears are results, not remedies.

questions.prompt: OBSERVE is to SCRUTINIZE as
questions.explanation: Scrutinize is a more intense form of observe; adore is a more intense form of like.

questions.prompt: ACROPHOBIA is to HEIGHTS as CLAUSTROPHOBIA is to
questions.explanation: Each is a fear of the thing named.

questions.prompt: TREE is to FOREST as STAR is to
questions.explanation: Many trees make up a forest; many stars make up a galaxy.

questions.prompt: LIBRARY is to BOOKS as ARMORY is to
questions.explanation: A library stores books; an armory stores weapons.

questions.prompt: COPILOT is to PILOT as VICE PRESIDENT is to
questions.explanation: Second in command to the first.

questions.prompt: INCH is to FOOT as CENTIMETER is to
questions.explanation: A smaller unit to the next standard unit in the same system.

questions.prompt: ALTRUISTIC is to SELFLESS as CANDID is to
questions.explanation: Synonyms.

questions.prompt: EMBARK is to DISEMBARK as ASCEND is to
questions.explanation: Opposites.

questions.prompt: PEN is to WRITE as KNIFE is to
questions.explanation: A tool and the action it performs.

questions.prompt: ENGINE is to CAR as
questions.explanation: The engine powers a car; the heart powers the body.

questions.prompt: FAMISHED is to HUNGRY as EXHAUSTED is to
questions.explanation: Famished is extremely hungry; exhausted is extremely tired.

questions.prompt: TEAM is to PLAYERS as CHOIR is to
questions.explanation: A group and its members.
